_doc: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Gold Edition (base game + Winter Assault), Relic Essence 1. install = the 'Dawn of War Gold' folder. Archives come from WXP.module (which requires W40k) in load order, then Engine. Soulstorm / Dark Crusade / mods: a profile per install with its own module (e.g. Soulstorm's DXP2.module).
name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War (Gold)

relic._doc_metres: 1 game unit ~ 1 m (the Guardsman is 1.954 units tall); a hint, the scale rule decides

rig_map.head: bip01 head
rig_map._doc: 3ds Max biped naming (bip01 ...) used by most DoW1 infantry; other rigs override per unit

backend._doc: DoW1 models are low-poly (the Guardsman's default set is 1,898 triangles) with no normal maps: no relief, and only a simple subdivision so the voxel remesh keeps the faceted shapes instead of Catmull-Clark rounding them away.
